documentation.content:
A rate from a product's currency to the settlement currency is missing or older than maxRateAgeHours. Those products answer CONFLICT when added to a cart or paid.

What to do: [Runbook](https://roberto-bustos-hernandez.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ARQ/pages/24772610#Tipos-de-cambio).
